scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent initially handled customer's opening outburst with empathy, but when Elizabeth suffered a second high-distress outburst at turn 36 regarding her mortgage payment, Zack gave a cold procedural response citing standard BACS 14-day rules without acknowledging her financial panic.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never paraphrased or restated the customer's billing problem in their own words, jumping straight from verification to transaction logs.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked the customer to repeat the date of the direct debit at turn 46, which Elizabeth had already clearly stated at turn 7.

grader.scenario: Double charge on monthly statement following package upgrade to Gigafast 900
grader.notes: Double billing dispute call handled by Zack. Customer experienced duplicate £57 deductions following upgrade to Gigafast 900. Agent handled opening distress well and owned the solution via an emergency faster payment, but failed Empathy on a second outburst regarding mortgage payments, failed Active Listening with a repeat question on the transaction date, and omitted paraphrasing.
